page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfc6.6xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 24 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The instance is equipped with 48.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core. No local storage or GPU accelerators are bundled with this instance type, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 8 Gbps.

The underlying Intel Xeon processor includes a cache hierarchy consisting of a 32 KB L1d cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 35 MB L3 cache. It supports advanced instruction sets such as Intel Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX, AVX512F, and AVX512_VNNI) for vector calculations and neural network acceleration, alongside AES cryptography, BMI2, ADX, and FMA for integer and bit manipulation.

Benchmark results place the ecs.hfc6.6xlarge in the average performance tier. It achieves a stress-ng single-core score of 1437.29 and a multi-core score of 23003.67, complemented by a PassMark CPU score of 23410.97. Memory performance tests show a read-only small block cached bandwidth of 1277.1 GB/sec and a large block uncached write bandwidth of 36.67 GB/sec. In application-level tests, the instance processes 21.93 million Redis SET operations per second, serves static web traffic at 16.94 GB/sec, and handles LLM inference for a 7B model at 34.41 tokens/sec for prompt processing and 12.51 tokens/sec for text generation.

Given its 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and lack of local storage, this instance offers a cost-efficient profile for compute-heavy workloads that do not require massive memory footprints or local NVMe drives. It is well-suited for tasks such as software compilation (evidenced by a Geekbench clang compilation score of 19083.0), ray tracing, high-throughput web serving, and moderate database operations.
